name: Monte Carlo MCP
description: Triage data quality alerts, trace table lineage, and create monitors in Monte Carlo data observability from Claude, Cursor, or any OAuth-capable MCP client.

skills.name: Alert Triage
skills.description: Lists recent Monte Carlo alerts, assesses each one, and updates their status so you know which data incidents to review first.

skills.name: Table Health And Lineage
skills.description: Searches tables, reports a table's current health, and walks its upstream lineage dependencies before you query or change it.

skills.name: Monitor Coverage Gaps
skills.description: Finds critical tables in a use case that have no monitors and drafts or updates table monitors to close those gaps.

skills.name: AI Agent Monitoring
skills.description: Reads AI agent metadata and traces and creates agent metric monitors to track the performance and reliability of your agents.

skills.name: Guided Incident Prompts
skills.description: Runs ready-made prompts such as mc-triage and mc-incident-response that chain Monte Carlo tools from triage to root cause.
